crossRefs.note: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

translations.web: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.
translations.bsb: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered.
translations.kjv: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
translations.asv: And all the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
